verdict.rationale: Azure documents a public REST API surface that clients call after registering with Microsoft Entra ID, scriptable with curl for unattended automation, with client libraries for most services; service-specific APIs like Cost Management are also documented. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show that guessed spec paths on the docs site don't exist, not that the API is missing. missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec found by probe, independent hands-on corroboration of direct REST API use (community praise covers the CLI, not the API).
